headline: UN science panel warns AI-agent safeguards are unravelling
body: The UN Independent International Scientific Panel on AI issued its first thematic brief, warning that safeguards for capable AI agents are not keeping pace and urging precaution on loss-of-control risk. Coming from a top-credibility source, it weakened Alignment & Control, which lifts Conquerors and Zookeeper and pulls down the bright endings that need safe AI. It also counted as a small step toward Global Coordination. Capability kept climbing: OpenAI said an internal model resolved more than 100 additional open math problems, and Xiaomi open-sourced a 1-trillion-parameter model under an MIT licence, spreading power more widely. Zookeeper moved ahead of Benevolent Dictator. Horizon Balance dropped to -9.28.
movers_note: Conquerors +0.8 (UN brief +0.69, OpenAI math +0.10), Protector God -0.6 (UN brief -0.69, partly offset by OpenAI math +0.10) and Benevolent Dictator -0.6 (UN brief -0.50, Xiaomi -0.07).
